meta.title: AgentBridge — Connector Contract & Execution Architecture
meta.subtitle: Provider-Neutral Boundary for MCP, REST, and CLI Integrations
meta.description: Architectural boundary and execution flow decoupling callers from concrete integration providers (MCP, REST, CLI), routing requests through permission and resilience boundaries, and recording operational history via universal request_id correlation.

states.label: Caller Submits Request
states.description: Agent runtime, ChatOps handler, or automated tool initiates a ConnectorRequest carrying a unique request_id, operation, and parameters.

states.label: PermissionEngine Verification
states.description: Caller checks operation against PolicyEngine rules before invocation. Operation may be allowed, denied, or queued for operator approval.

states.label: Permission Denied
states.description: Operation halted by security policy. Emits permission event to ActivityStore and returns authorization error.

states.label: Connector Contract Boundary
states.description: Caller invokes connector.execute(request). Abstract interface enforces capability declaration and connected state.

states.label: Capability Check
states.description: Validates that the connector explicitly declares the capability required by the operation (e.g. tool_execution, discovery, read, write).

states.label: Capability Error
states.description: Rejects request with ConnectorInvalidRequestError without invoking downstream provider.

states.label: Centralized Resilience Execution
states.description: Operation executes through shared with_timeout_and_retry and CircuitBreaker infrastructure.

states.label: Provider Implementation
states.description: Concrete transport adapter (future MCP stdio/HTTP, REST client, CLI process) executes the native protocol call.

states.label: Result Normalization & Redaction
states.description: Translates provider response into provider-neutral ConnectorResult, redacting secrets from content and metadata.

states.label: ActivityStore Telemetry
states.description: Records connector_events and tool_calls into shared SQLite database using universal request_id correlation.

states.label: Deliver Normalized Result
states.description: Returns ConnectorResult to calling agent or ChatOps pipeline.
